blocks.text: It shall be unlawful for any person to mix or make mortar, plaster or cement upon any paved street, avenue or alley in the City, unless such mortar, plaster or cement is mixed or made in a tight box provided for such purpose. (Code 1981 § 40-30. Code 1995 § 130-6.)
